name: SENDUNE Free
free_limit: SENDUNE dashboard free plan for up to 1,000 contacts and 3,000 emails per month, with no SENDUNE subscription fee and no card required by SENDUNE.
watch_out: Requires connecting your own Amazon SES account. AWS bills SES sending directly, including during SENDUNE's free plan; this is NOT 3,000 emails of free AWS delivery. AWS account/payment setup may require a card. Verify AWS charges, SES sending limits and commercial terms before use.
